title: Offline Lab Package Metadata
description: Metadata JSON file generated by buildctl and shipped alongside the DDI (.raw). Immutable after publication. See docs/specs/package-format.md.

spec_version.description: Schema version. Always '1' for this version of the spec.

format_version.description: Package format version. '1' = DDI format (UAPI.3 GPT image with root, verity, and signature partitions). Distinguishes this from the legacy 5-file format, which carried no format_version field.

name.description: Package name. Lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens only. Must start with alphanumeric.

version.description: Package version. Must be valid semver.

description.description: Single-line human-readable description of the package.

homepage.description: Package or upstream project homepage URL.

tags.description: Classification tags used for repository search and filtering.

security_contact.description: Email address or URL for vulnerability disclosure.

sbom_url.description: URL to a published SBOM for this package. Null if not provided.

signing_key_id.description: SHA-256 fingerprint (hex) of the build key that signed the DDI signature partition. Nullable for key-rotation support; null when rotation is not in use. See docs/specs/security-model.md.

runtime.description: Runtime mode. Always explicit in metadata: buildctl copies this from package.yaml, defaulting to 'portable' when absent there. 'portable' = systemd portable service with a per-app uid drop-in. 'nspawn' = systemd-nspawn with namespace isolation.

network.description: Network mode. Present only when runtime = 'nspawn' and the author set it in package.yaml; otherwise omitted entirely.

command.description: Absolute path to the service entrypoint inside the DDI root filesystem. Present only when the author set it in package.yaml; retained for traceability.

ddi_artifact.description: Filename of the DDI artifact, following the UAPI.3 underscore convention: <name>_<version>_<arch>.raw. The verity hash tree and PKCS7 signature live inside this image's GPT partitions, not as companion files.

ddi_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the DDI .raw file, lowercase hex. Used for pre-install integrity checks and cache validation.

ddi_size.description: Size of the DDI .raw file in bytes (includes GPT, root squashfs, verity partition, and signature partition). Larger than the legacy bare squashfs due to verity overhead; used for pre-install storage checks.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the package was built.

systemd_profile.description: systemd portable service security profile. 'custom' means unit files inside the DDI root partition carry their own hardening.

socket_activation.description: If true, the service uses socket activation. A .socket unit must exist inside the DDI root partition.

config.description: Namespace path for the config volume (e.g. /etc/mosquitto). appctl generates a BindPaths= drop-in at install time.

data.description: Namespace path for the data volume (e.g. /var/lib/mosquitto). appctl generates a BindPaths= drop-in at install time.

volumes.description: Persistent volume mappings. At most two keys: config and data. Apps log via stderr/stdout to the systemd journal — no log volume.

ports.description: Network ports the service listens on. May be empty.

devices.description: Hardware devices the service requires or optionally uses. May be empty.

resources.description: Expected resource usage at three load levels. Optional — if absent, appctl skips the resource check.

lifecycle.description: Lifecycle hook unit names. Omitted entirely when the app has no hooks.

expose.description: If true, an nftables accept rule is applied for this port on install.

required.description: If false, the service starts even if the device is absent.

cpu_percent.description: Sustained CPU usage as a percentage of one core.

storage_mb.description: Disk space in MB (DDI root partition + data dir combined).

pre_start.description: Unit name to run after portablectl attach, before enable and first start.

post_start.description: Unit name to run after the service is running for the first time.

pre_update.description: Unit name to run after new image is attached, before service restart.

post_update.description: Unit name to run after the service is running on the new image.

pre_remove.description: Unit name to run before the service is stopped and the image is detached.
